## Fetch ICHIs  

### Description  
Endpoint for fetching ICHIs.  

### Endpoint  
Method: `GET`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/terminology/v1/ichi?search={{search}}&id_code={{id_code}}&code={{code}}&target={{target}}&action={{action}}&mean={{mean}}`  

### URL Variables  

| Variable       | Description                      | Example                      |  
|---------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke`      |  

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the URL query string.  

| Parameter    | Type   | Required | Description                                      | Example              |  
|-------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------|  
| `search`    | String | ❌ No    | Global search filters for ICHIs based on `clean_title`. | `Test of orientation functions` |  
| `id_code`   | String | ❌ No    | Search by specific `id_code`.                   | `ATD.AC.ZZ`          |  
| `code`      | String | ❌ No    | Search by specific `code`.                      | `ATD.AC.ZZ`          |  
| `target`    | String | ❌ No    | Search by specific `target`.                    | `ATD`                |  
| `action`    | String | ❌ No    | Search by specific `action`.                    | `AC`                 |  
| `mean`      | String | ❌ No    | Search by specific `mean`.                      | `AC`                 |  

## Authorization  
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.  

### Headers  

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |  
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes  | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  

## Sample Body  

```json
{}
```

## Example Request (cURL)  

```sh
curl -X GET "https://uat.dha.go.ke/terminology/v1/ichi?search=Test%20of%20orientation%20functions&id_code=ATD.AC.ZZ&code=ATD.AC.ZZ&target=ATD&action=AC&mean=AC" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
```

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
  "IsSuccess": true,
  "Message": "Success",
  "Errors": [],
  "Data": {
    "ichi": [
      {
        "id_code": "ATD.AC.ZZ",
        "clean_title": "Test of orientation functions",
        "code_level": 6,
        "code": "ATD.AC.ZZ",
        "id_code_path": "ICHI Category > Health interventions > Interventions on body systems or functions > Interventions on the nervous system or mental functions > BlockL4-AT2 > BlockL5-ATD > ATD.AC.ZZ",
        "title_path": "ICHI Category > Health interventions > Interventions on body systems or functions > Interventions on the nervous system or mental functions > Interventions on global mental functions > Interventions on orientation functions > Test of orientation functions",
        "block_id": null,
        "target": "ATD",
        "action": "AC",
        "mean": "AC",
        "class_kind": "category"
      }
    ],
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## Fetch ICD11  

### Description  
This API endpoint allows users to retrieve ICD-11 (International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision) codes, which are used for categorizing diseases, disorders, and other health-related conditions. It provides a search functionality based on the disease description or a specific ICD-11 code. The results include details such as the ICD-11 code, a brief description of the condition, and a direct link to the official World Health Organization (WHO) ICD-11 browser for further reference.  

This endpoint is useful for healthcare providers, medical researchers, and digital health platforms that need to integrate standardized disease classification into their systems.  

### Endpoint  
Method: `GET`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/terminology/v1/icd11?search={{search}}&icd_11_code={{icd_11_code}}`  

### URL Variables  

| Variable       | Description                      | Example                      |  
|---------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke`      |  

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the URL query string.  

| Parameter      | Type   | Required | Description                                         | Example    |  
|---------------|--------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|  
| `search`      | String | ❌ No    | Performs a global search for ICD-11 codes based on the disease description. Example: "Cholera". | `Cholera` |  
| `icd_11_code` | String | ❌ No    | Searches for a specific ICD-11 code. If provided, it will return details about that particular code. | `1A00`     |  

## Authorization  
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.  

### Headers  

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |  
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes  | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  

## Sample Body  

```json
{}
```

## Example Request (cURL)  

```sh
curl -X GET "https://uat.dha.go.ke/terminology/v1/icd11?search=Cholera&icd_11_code=1A00" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
```

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
  "IsSuccess": true,
  "Message": "Success",
  "Errors": [],
  "Data": {
    "icd11": [
      {
        "icd_11_code": "1A00",
        "description": "Cholera",
        "browser_url": "https://icd.who.int/browse/2024-01/mms/en#257068224"
      }
    ],
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## Fetch Active Components  

### Description  
This API endpoint retrieves active pharmaceutical components, which are the biologically active ingredients in medications. It provides the ability to search for active components using various filters such as component descriptions, exact matches, and specific active component IDs.  

Healthcare providers, pharmacists, and digital health systems can use this endpoint to integrate structured medication data into their applications, ensuring accurate drug information retrieval.  

### Endpoint  
Method: `GET`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/terminology/v1/active-component?search={{search}}&exact_match={{exact_match}}&active_component_id={{active_component_id}}`  

### URL Variables  

| Variable       | Description                      | Example                      |  
|---------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke`      |  

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the URL query string.  

| Parameter             | Type    | Required | Description                                                                         | Example     |  
|----------------------|---------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|  
| `search`            | String  | ❌ No    | Performs a global search for active components based on component descriptions. Example: "Metformin". | `Metformin` |  
| `exact_match`       | Boolean | ❌ No    | If `true`, the search will return only exact matches; otherwise, broader search results are included. | `true` or `false` |  
| `active_component_id` | Integer | ❌ No    | Searches for a specific active component using its unique identifier. | `1`         |  

## Authorization  
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.  

### Headers  

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |  
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes  | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  



## Example Request (cURL)  

```sh
curl -X GET "https://uat.dha.go.ke/terminology/v1/active-component?search=Metformin&exact_match=true&active_component_id=1" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
```

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
  "IsSuccess": true,
  "Message": "Success",
  "Errors": [],
  "Data": {
    "ac": [
      {
        "active_component_id": 1,
        "component_description": "Metformin",
        "component_links": [
          {
            "active_component_link_id": 1,
            "active_component_line": 1,
            "active_component_id": 1,
            "component_name": "Metformin",
            "component_atc_code": "A10BA02"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## Fetch Products  

### Description  
This API endpoint retrieves product details from the terminology system, including brand and generic names, dosage forms, and regulatory identifiers. It allows filtering by various parameters such as product ID, generic concept ID, form ID, and route ID.  

Healthcare providers, pharmacies, and digital health applications can use this endpoint to fetch product details for better inventory management, prescription accuracy, and pharmaceutical research.  

### Endpoint  
Method: `GET`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/terminology/v1/product?search={{search}}&product_id={{product_id}}&generic_concept_id={{generic_concept_id}}&form_id={{form_id}}&route_id={{route_id}}`  

### URL Variables  

| Variable       | Description                      | Example                      |  
|---------------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke`      |  

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the URL query string.  

| Parameter              | Type    | Required | Description | Example |  
|------------------------|---------|----------|-------------|---------|  
| `search`              | String  | ❌ No    | Global search filter based on brand name, generic name, route description, form description, PPB registration code, ETCD, or KNHTS concept ID. Example: "Metformin". | `Metformin` |  
| `product_id`          | Integer | ❌ No    | Search for a specific product by its unique identifier. | `4855` |  
| `generic_concept_id`  | Integer | ❌ No    | Search by specific generic concept identifier. | `2` |  
| `form_id`            | Integer | ❌ No    | Search for a product by its dosage form ID. | `1` |  
| `route_id`           | Integer | ❌ No    | Search by specific administration route ID. | `1` |  

## Authorization  
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.  

### Headers  

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |  
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes  | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  

## Sample Body  

```json
{}
```

## Example Request (cURL)  

```sh
curl -X GET "https://uat.dha.go.ke/terminology/v1/product?search=Metformin&product_id=4855" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
  "IsSuccess": true,
  "Message": "Success",
  "Errors": [],
  "Data": {
    "products": [
      {
        "product_id": 4855,
        "generic_concept_id": 2,
        "brand_display_name": "Glucodeal 500 mg Oral Tablet",
        "generic_display_name": "Metformin 500 mg Oral Tablet",
        "brand_name": "Glucodeal",
        "generic_name": "Metformin",
        "strength_amount": "500",
        "strength_unit": "mg",
        "route_description": "Oral",
        "form_description": "Tablet",
        "ppb_registration_code": "77",
        "etcd": "3913",
        "knhts_concept_id": "10-03913-01",
        "updation_date": "2024-12-21T04:56:04.243Z"
      }
    ],
    "count": 1
  }
}
```

## Tiberbu Detach Dependant v2  

### Description  
This API allows a **client** to remove dependants who were added from external sources but **do not belong to them**. This operation now requires an **encrypted PIN** for security verification.  

---

### Endpoint  
**Method:** `PUT`  
**URL:** `{{base_url}}/v2/detach-dependant`  

---

### URL Variables  
| Variable        | Description                           | Example                      |  
|----------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server.     | `https://api-uat.tiberbu.health` |  

---

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the request body.  

| Parameter          | Type   | Required | Description                                      | Example                 |  
|-------------------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|  
| `agent`          | String | ✅ Yes   | The unique identifier of the requesting agent.  | `AGENT00123`            |  
| `id`             | String | ✅ Yes   | The unique client ID of the principal.         | `CR123456789-2`         |  
| `dependant_cr_id`| String | ✅ Yes   | The unique client ID of the dependant to detach. | `CR987654321-2`         |  
| `encrypted_pin`  | String | ✅ Yes   | The encrypted PIN for authentication.          | `"xxxxxxxxxxxx"`        |  

---

## Authorization  
This request requires **Basic Authentication**. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the **Kenya Digital Superhighway** and include a valid **JWT token** generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.  

### Headers  
The request must include an authentication token obtained from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.  

| Header Key       | Value Format            | Required | Description                                     |  
|-----------------|------------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>`    | ✅ Yes   | A valid JWT token for authentication.          |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`      | ✅ Yes   | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  

---

## Sample Body  

```json
{
    "agent": "AGENT00123",
    "id": "CR123456789-2",
    "dependant_cr_id": "CR987654321-2",
    "encrypted_pin": "xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

---

## Example Request (cURL)  

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api-uat.tiberbu.health/v2/detach-dependant" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_username:password>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "agent": "AGENT00123",
        "id": "CR123456789-2",
        "dependant_cr_id": "CR987654321-2",
        "encrypted_pin": "xxxxxxxxxxxx"
      }'
```

---

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
    "status": "success",
    "message": "Dependant successfully detached.",
    "data": {
        "id": "CR123456789-2",
        "dependant_cr_id": "CR987654321-2",
        "detached_at": "2025-02-26T14:30:00Z"
    }
}
```

## Tiberbu Update Client by Agent v3  

### Description  
This API allows an **agent** to edit blacklisted client fields. Only select fields can be updated, and each field can only be updated **once**. An **encrypted PIN** is now required for this operation.  

---

### Endpoint  
**Method:** `PUT`  
**URL:** `{{base_url}}/v3/agent-update-client`  

---

### URL Variables  
| Variable        | Description                           | Example                      |  
|----------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|  
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server.     | `https://api-uat.tiberbu.health` |  

---

## Requests  

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the request body.  

| Parameter         | Type   | Required | Description                                       | Example                |  
|------------------|--------|----------|---------------------------------------------------|------------------------|  
| `id`            | String | ✅ Yes   | The unique client ID.                            | `CR123456789-2`         |  
| `agent`         | String | ✅ Yes   | The unique identifier of the requesting agent.   | `AGENT00123`           |  
| `encrypted_pin` | String | ✅ Yes   | The encrypted PIN for authentication.           | `"xxxxxxxxxxxx"`       |  
| `gender`        | String | ✅ Yes   | The updated gender of the client.                | `"Male"`               |  

---

## Authorization  
This request requires **Basic Authentication**. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the **Kenya Digital Superhighway** and include a valid **JWT token** generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.  

### Headers  
The request must include an authentication token obtained from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.  

| Header Key       | Value Format            | Required | Description                                     |  
|-----------------|------------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------|  
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>`    | ✅ Yes   | A valid JWT token for authentication.          |  
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`      | ✅ Yes   | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |  

---

## Sample Body  

```json
{
    "id": "CR123456789-2",
    "agent": "AGENT00123",
    "encrypted_pin": "xxxxxxxxxxxx",
    "gender": "Male"
}
```

---

## Example Request (cURL)  

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api-uat.tiberbu.health/v3/agent-update-client" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_username:password>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "id": "CR123456789-2",
        "agent": "AGENT00123",
        "encrypted_pin": "xxxxxxxxxxxx",
        "gender": "Male"
      }'
```

---

## Example Response (JSON)  

```json
{
    "status": "success",
    "message": "Client details updated successfully.",
    "data": {
        "id": "CR123456789-2",
        "updated_fields": ["gender"],
        "last_updated": "2025-02-26T14:00:00Z"
    }
}
```

## Tiberbu Send Web OTP
### Description
Send OTP for specific use cases such as Registration, Login, or Adding a Spouse.

### Endpoint
Method: `POST`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/send-web-otp`

### URL Variables
| Variable      | Description                      | Example                  |
|--------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------|
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke` |

## Requests

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the request body.

| Parameter                | Type   | Required | Description                              | Example         |  
|--------------------------|--------|----------|------------------------------------------|-----------------|  
| `identification_type`   | String | ✅ Yes   | Type of identification document.         | `National ID`   |  
| `identification_number` | String | ✅ Yes   | The client's identification number.      | `1234567890`    |  
| `otp_type`             | Integer | ✅ Yes   | Type of OTP being requested.             | `3` (Registration/Login) |  
| `agent`                 | String | ✅ Yes   | The agent requesting the OTP.            | `AGENT001`      |  

---

## Authorization
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.

### Headers
The request must include an authentication token obtained from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes  | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |

## Sample Body

```json
{
  "identification_type": "National ID",
  "identification_number": "1234567890",
  "otp_type": 3,
  "agent": "AGENT001"
}
```

## Example Request (cURL)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api-uat.tiberbu.health/send-web-otp" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_username:password>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "identification_type": "National ID",
        "identification_number": "1234567890",
        "otp_type": 3,
        "agent": "AGENT001"
      }'
```

## Example Response (JSON)
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "OTP sent successfully",
  "otp_reference": "a4klufn4o0"
}
```

post.description:
## Tiberbu UAT Validate OTP in CR v4
### Description
This API validates a One-Time Password (OTP) and, if successful, executes the associated action. If the OTP type is **3**, the API will add a spouse for the client. The OTP must be valid and issued for the intended operation.

### Endpoint
Method: `POST`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/v4/tiberbu-validate-otp`

### URL Variables
| Variable        | Description                      | Example                  |
|----------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------|
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke` |

## Requests

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the request body.

| Parameter       | Type   | Required | Description                                         | Example       |  
|----------------|--------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------|  
| `agent`       | String | ✅ Yes   | The agent processing the OTP validation request.   | `AGENT001`    |  
| `otp_record`  | String | ✅ Yes   | A valid OTP reference from the **Send Web OTP** API. | `OTP123456`  |  
| `otp`         | String | ✅ Yes   | The one-time password provided by the user.        | `22445`       |  
| `encrypted_pin` | String | ✅ Yes   | The encrypted PIN for security validation.         | `********`    |  

---

## Authorization
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.

### Headers
The request must include an authentication token obtained from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |

## Sample Body

```json
{
  "agent": "AGENT001",
  "otp_record": "OTP123456",
  "otp": "22445",
  "encrypted_pin": "********"
}
```

## Example Request (cURL)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api-uat.tiberbu.health/v4/tiberbu-validate-otp" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_username:password>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "agent": "AGENT001",
        "otp_record": "OTP123456",
        "otp": "22445",
        "encrypted_pin": "********"
      }'
```

## Example Response (JSON)
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "OTP validated successfully",
  "action": "Spouse added to client profile"
}
```

## Tiberbu Web CR Registration
### Description
This API is used for registering new clients in the system. A valid OTP of type **Registration** is required to complete the process. The registration must be initiated by an authorized agent.

### Endpoint
Method: `POST`  
URL: `{{base_url}}/web-cr-registration`

### URL Variables
| Variable        | Description                      | Example                  |
|----------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------|
| `{{base_url}}` | The base URL of the API server. | `https://uat.dha.go.ke` |

## Requests

### Request Parameters  
These parameters must be included in the request body.

| Parameter       | Type   | Required | Description                                         | Example           |  
|----------------|--------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------|-------------------|  
| `agent`       | String | ✅ Yes   | The agent processing the registration request.     | `AGENT001`        |  
| `encrypted_pin` | String | ✅ Yes   | The encrypted PIN for security validation.         | `********`        |  
| `otp_record`  | String | ✅ Yes   | A valid OTP reference from the **Send Web OTP** API. | `a4klufn4o0`      |  
| `first_name`  | String | ✅ Yes   | The first name of the client being registered.     | `John`            |  

---

## Authorization
This request requires Basic Authentication. Ensure you provide the correct credentials from the Kenya Digital Superhighway and include a valid JWT token generated from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint in the request headers.

### Headers
The request must include an authentication token obtained from the **Generate JWT Token** endpoint.

| Header Key       | Value Format      | Required | Description |
|-----------------|------------------|----------|-------------|
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <jwt-token>` | ✅ Yes | A valid JWT token for authentication. |
| `Content-Type`  | `application/json`   | ✅ Yes | Specifies that the request body is in JSON format. |

## Sample Body

```json
{
  "agent": "AGENT001",
  "encrypted_pin": "********",
  "otp_record": "a4klufn4o0",
  "first_name": "John"
}
```

## Example Request (cURL)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api-uat.tiberbu.health/web-cr-registration" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_username:password>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "agent": "AGENT001",
        "encrypted_pin": "********",
        "otp_record": "a4klufn4o0",
        "first_name": "John"
      }'
```

## Example Response (JSON)
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Client registered successfully",
  "client_id": "CR123456789"
}
```

## Tiberbu Check Account Status v2

| `{{base_url}}`  | The base URL of the API server.                   | `https://uat.dha.go.ke` |
